description: First-class support for re-export edges (`export * from './x'`, `export { Y } from './y'`) as a distinct `EdgeKind`; expose `module → declaration` mappings even when nothing is imported directly.

requirements.description: The graph extraction must provide first-class support for TypeScript re-export patterns. Export-all statements (export * from './x') and named re-exports (export { Y } from './y') must be represented as distinct RE_EXPORT EdgeKind entries in the graph. Module-to-declaration mappings must be present in the graph even for declarations that are never directly imported by other files, enabling analysis of barrel-file exposure surfaces. The re-export chain must be traceable through multiple barrel levels.
requirements.title: Barrel-File and Re-Export Edge Coverage

validation.notes: Test that 'export * from ./x' produces a RE_EXPORT edge from the barrel module to the source module
Test that 'export { Y } from ./y' produces a RE_EXPORT edge with Y as the exported symbol identifier
Test that a declaration only exposed via barrel (never directly imported) still appears in the graph
Test multi-level re-export chain (A re-exports from B which re-exports from C) produces correct edge chain
TCG-REEXPORT: Extract a fixture with an index.ts barrel file using export * and export { } patterns; verify RE_EXPORT edges in the graph
Verify module-to-declaration mappings are present for unexported declarations in a barrel-only scenario
react-component-library can identify all publicly re-exported components via the graph without manually tracing barrel files

title: Barrel-File and Re-Export Coverage
